note: Accepted post-cleanup absolute ceilings. base-vs-head comparison is enforced by scripts/perf/compare.mjs; this file guards absolute drift and is regenerated (reviewed) when a cost increase is intentional. Size ceilings = captured bytes +5%; runtime ceilings carry noise headroom over the captured median; byte ceilings are proportional (x1.75) so a small scenario is not swallowed by an additive floor sized for a large one. baselineRef names the commit that was MEASURED, which for a working-tree capture is not a released tag. Reproduce a capture with an ordinary build of that commit: the first-party Canvas2D renderer is the only renderer, so no environment variable selects it. core:style.css was re-recorded from 12,995 when the shared tooltip sheet moved into the global layer: those rules previously shipped twice over, inside Toolbar's and AnnotationShapeOverlay's scoped blocks, which svelte-package hands to a component consumer as part of each component rather than as part of this file. The sheet grew; what a consumer transfers fell.

av:esm-entry.reason: New artifact family: the base ref predates @triiiceratops/plugin-av, so there is nothing to diff its entry against.

av:iife.reason: New artifact family: the base ref predates @triiiceratops/plugin-av. This is the artifact the competitive pair budget in scripts/size-check.mjs actually gates; the ratchet on its gzip lives in the plugin's own check-shared-runtime.mjs.

av:iife-chunk-hls.reason: New artifact family, and deliberately large: hls.js is fetched only when an HLS body must play on a browser with no native HLS. These bytes are never in the entry and never in the pair budget.

av:iife-chunk-waveform.reason: New artifact family: fetched only when a canvas links waveform data.

av:iife-chunk-sequencer.reason: New artifact family: fetched only when a canvas is painted by several time-based bodies tiling its duration. These bytes are never in the entry and never in the pair budget.

av:iife-chunk-transcript.reason: New artifact family: the transcript panel, fetched only when the current canvas carries a VTT track that loaded with cues in it. These bytes are never in the entry and never in the pair budget.
